headline: New Headquarters Office Building for IAPSER / Sebastian Stechina + Carlos Di Napoli + Andres Francesconi
context: On the edge where Paraná's urban fabric meets the river, an office building designed in exposed reinforced concrete offers a contemporary, high-performance image. The project was developed based on the winning entry of a design competition held for this purpose in 2019.
